title: notify-relay is socket-activated, but nothing answers at its documented socket path
description_md:
`notify-relay` is supposed to accept local notifications over a Unix socket at `/run/notify-relay.sock` -- every client and healthcheck on this box uses that exact path. `notify-relay.socket` is active and `notify-relay.service` looks completely normal (inactive, waiting to be triggered -- that's expected for a socket-activated service that hasn't received a connection yet), yet nothing ever answers at `/run/notify-relay.sock`. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), work out what the socket unit is actually listening on, and get it back on the path everything else expects.

You're done when a request to `/run/notify-relay.sock` gets a real response.
